Faye & David,
I am very excited to share with the both of you our estimate proposal for your entire business insurance package. (General Liability, Umbrella, WC, Inland Marine, Property, & Commercial Auto)
 Key Highlights of the Proposal:
 1. Program Structure Simplification
 Unified Renewal Date : All policies aligned to a single renewal date.
 Single Broker & COI : One broker and one Certificate of Insurance (COI) simplifies administration.
 Efficiency Gains : COIs sent once annually in bulk, rather than multiple times (e.g., June for WC, March for other policies).
 2. General Liability Improvements
 Rate Reduction : Current rate is $33.25 per $1,000 in payroll. Proposed rate is $20.00 per $1,000.
 Immediate Savings : Estimated savings of $8,387 .
 Long Term Savings : Since the rate is lower as the company grows general liability and umbrella costs will rise more slowly as opposed to now with the current $33.25 rate.
 3. Commercial Auto Enhancements
 Carrier Change : Transition from State Farm to a new, competitive carrier.
 Cost Reduction : Current cost is $5,613 per vehicle; proposed cost is $4,650 per vehicle.
 Coverage Optimization : Removal of uninsured motorist coverage, as employees are covered under Workers’ Comp in case of accidents.
 4. Workers’ Compensation Benefits
 Discounts Applied :
 Drug-Free Credit
 Safety Credit
Combined total discount: 7% ( $1,068)
 Dividend Opportunity :
Up to 35% dividend  based on loss performance.
With your excellent track record, potential dividend equals $4,969 .
 5. Property Coverage Trade-Off
 Deductible Adjustment : Current deductible is $1,000; proposed deductible is $5,000.
 Note : This is the only area where the new program is less favorable.
 6. Total Financial Impact
 Savings without the Dividend : $23,840
 Savings with the Dividend : $28,811
 Understanding Your Insurance Companies
I want to make sure you know exactly what you’re buying and feel confident about the insurance companies we’re recommending. These aren’t just names—we’ve chosen carriers that are financially strong and reliable.
There’s a nationwide and international rating bureau called AM Best  that evaluates the financial strength of insurance companies. You can check their ratings here:
 🔗
 https://web.ambest.com/ratings-services/bests-credit-ratings
 Proposed Insurance Carriers
